notes.title: Exciting News: Introducing the Chinese Language Update to Our App!
notes.notes:
Hey there, Steam Community!

We are beyond excited to unveil a brand-new enhancement to our application that is bound to take your experience to a whole new level. We are thrilled to announce that our app is now available in Chinese, bringing a whole new dimension to your interaction with our Virtual Museum.

Join us on this exciting journey as we open the doors to a wider audience and celebrate the boundless reach of artistry and language. The Chinese version of our app is more than an update; it's an invitation to explore, connect, and revel in the world of creativity.

Thank you for being an integral part of our Steam family. Your support and enthusiasm continue to drive us to create experiences that transcend borders and language barriers.

notes.title: Don't miss the update! 12 brand new, glorious art galleries!
notes.notes:
We are introducing 12 brand new, glorious art galleries! Step into a world where creativity knows no bounds and immerse yourself in a captivating journey through these stunning spaces.

Experience the timeless elegance of classic art or let your imagination run wild in the realms of fantasy. These galleries are an absolute must-see for art enthusiasts of all tastes.
